arabic text:
HAEY, KHUDA NE JAB MALAKUL MAUT KO YE IZN DIYA
KE ROOHE HAZRAT-E-SARWAR NIKAAL KAR LE AA
RAHAY KHAYAAL KE, SHABBIR KO NA HO EEZAA
HUSSAIN, HUSSAIN, HUSSAIN PEHLE HI ZAKHMO SE
CHUR CHUR HUA
MALAK PUKARA YE, MUJH SAY NA HO SAKE GA KHUDAA
english translation text:
Alas! When God permitted the Angel of Death
to bring back the soul of the Master,
He commanded: ‘Take care that Shabbir suffers no further pain.’
Hussain—Hussain—Hussain was already
covered from head to toe in wounds.
The angel cried: ‘My Lord, I cannot do this.’

arabic text: MAIN KIS TARHA SE NIKALOON, BADAN SE JAAN-E-\nHUSSAIN\nBOHAT HI SAKHT HAY YA RAB, YE IMTEHAN-E-HUSSAIN
english translation text: How can I draw the soul of\nHussain from his body? My Lord, this\ntrial of Hussain is unbearably severe.

arabic text:
HAEY, LAGA HAI ZAKHM TABAR, BEH RAHA HAI SAR SE
LAHOO
BHARE HAIN KHOON MEIN JAANE RASOOL KE GESU
QAREEB JAAKE RAKHOON DIL PE KIS TARAH QABOO
KE IS LAHOO MEIN THO HAI FATEMA KE DOODH KI BU
english translation text:
Alas! An axe-wound has struck him, and blood flows
from his head. The beloved of the Prophet’s
hair is soaked in blood. How can I
go near and control my heart, when even
this blood carries the fragrance of Fatima’s milk?

arabic text:
HAEY, MAY PHIR IN-AANKHON PE DHAOON SITAM YE
KYA HAY ZAROOR
BICHAR KE JO ALI AKBER SE HO GAYEEN BENOOR
NIDA YE AAYI DAHAN SE NIKAAL JAANE HUZOOR
KAHA DAHAN MEIN THO KAANTE PADE HAIN RABBE
GHAFOOR
english translation text:
Alas! Must I inflict this further pain
upon those eyes— eyes already blinded by
separation from Ali Akbar? A command came:
‘Draw the Master’s soul from his mouth.’
The angel said: ‘His mouth is
filled with thorns, O Forgiving Lord.’

arabic text:
NIDA YE AAYI KE GARDAN SE KHYNCHNA IN KI
KAHA MY KYA KAHOON GARDEN PE CHAL RAHI HAI
CHURI
CHURI PAKADKE YE CHILLATI HAY KOI BIBI
NA ZIBHA KAR MERE BACCHE KO MAI DUWA DOONGI
english translation text:
The command came: ‘Draw it from his neck.’
The angel replied: ‘What can I say? A
blade is passing over his throat. A Lady
has seized the knife and cries: “Do not
slaughter my child; I will pray for you.”’

arabic text: HAEY, NIDA YE AAYI KE SEENE SE QABZ KAR LE JAAN\nKAHA WO TEERON SE CHALNI HAY AEY MERE REHMAAN
english translation text: Alas! The command came: ‘Take his soul from his chest.’\nHe replied: ‘O Merciful Lord, his chest is riddled with arrows.’

arabic text: ABHI THO MAARKE BARCHI HATA THA EK SHAITAN\nAUR AB TO HAY TAHE ZAANUYE SHIMR YE QURAAN
english translation text: A devil has only just withdrawn his spear,\nand now this Qur’an lies beneath Shimr’s knees.

arabic text:
HAEY, NIDA YE AAYI KE MAZLOOMIYET KAY RUTBA
SHINAS
QAMR SE KHYNCHLE KAABE KI JAAN BE WASWAAS
KAHA MALAK NE TARAP KAR BA-DARDO HASRATO YAAS
QAMAR THO TOOT GAYI, JABSE MAR GAYE ABBAS
english translation text:
Alas! The command came: ‘O knower of the
rank of the oppressed, draw the soul of
the Kaaba from his waist without fear.’ The
angel cried in anguish and despair: ‘His
back was broken when Abbas was killed.’

arabic text:
FALAK SE TAB HUA ROOHUL AMEE KA RAN MEIN
NUZOOL
KAHA PUKAR KE MUH DHAMP LO BARAYE BATOOL
PISAR KE LAASH PE KHOLEGI BAAL BINTE RASOOL
SADA YE THI MALAKUL MAUTH KI BA HUZN MALOOL
english translation text:
Then Ruh-ul-Ameen descended from the heavens to the
battlefield. He cried: ‘Cover your faces for the
sake of Batool; the Prophet’s daughter will loosen
her hair over her son’s body.’ The Angel
of Death spoke with grief and sorrow:

arabic text:
HAEY, ISAY YE HUKM HU PAR-FIKR-YE HAY AY YAZDAAN
HAR EK JUZV HAY ZAKHMI LAGAAOON HAATH KAHAN
KHUDA PUKARA YE MUSHKIL KARENGE HUM AASAAN
NA TU NIKAAL MERE AASHIQE GHAREEB KI JAAN
MAY KHUD NIKAL RAHA HOON BADAN SE JAAN-E-
HUSSAIN
KE KHATM HONAY KO AB HAY YEH IMTEHAN-E-HUSSAIN
english translation text:
Alas! ‘My Lord, every part of him is
wounded—where can I place my hand?’ God
replied: ‘We shall make this difficulty easy.
Do not take the soul of My
forsaken beloved. I Myself shall draw the
soul of Hussain from his body, for
Hussain’s trial has now reached its end.’
